No test file enumerates all kinds requiring a mandatory update — those are fine without changes. I have enough to answer confidently.

The `NotificationKind` union has one canonical source (`src/types/notification.ts`) with two other places that mirror it verbatim for runtime validation and DB storage, plus a compile-time parity check tying them together. Two docs spell out the literal 11-value list / count.

**Source files:**
- `src/types/notification.ts` — the `NotificationKind` union itself (source of truth)
- `src/schemas/notification.ts` — `notificationKindSchema` (zod `z.enum([...])` mirrors the union) and the `_kindParity` compile-time check
- `src/server/db/schema/notifications.ts` — `NOTIFICATION_KINDS` const array used for both `notifications.kind` and `notification_preferences.kind` column enums

**Documents:**
- `docs/db/tables-notifications-and-activity.md` — spells out the full 11-value `NOTIFICATION_KINDS` list and the "eleven-times multiplier" note under invariants
- `docs/api/actions-notifications.md` — states "`kind` | closed enum, 11 values" for `updateNotificationPreferenceAction`'s input

ANSWER: src/types/notification.ts, src/schemas/notification.ts, src/server/db/schema/notifications.ts, docs/db/tables-notifications-and-activity.md, docs/api/actions-notifications.md
